answer: An admission auction prices sybils out. Each epoch seats are auctioned: sealed POA bids, top bidders win a seat and reward share. Honest demand sets the clearing price, so 1,000 fake seats at 5 POA each lock 5,000 POA, a canyon-sized gap against one honest agent's 5 POA bid. The price delta between one honest bid and a thousand hostile bids grows with every fake identity, while the small kernel of winners grades each other's answers and sock-puppets earn nothing.
